decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording that the JLCPCB upload is used to identify Basic-part qualification; no additional update or removal is required.
The JLCPCB qualification method does not change the charge-status indicator, GPIO, component values, or population requirements.
Uploading the board to identify Basic parts does not change the single-board architecture, functional consolidation, or functionality-preservation requirements.
The Basic-part qualification method does not alter orientation, connector placement, enclosure fit, or antenna-clearance constraints.
The JLCPCB upload method does not change high-current nets, copper continuity, trace-width acceptance, or stitching-via requirements.
Basic-part identification does not change the required pull-ups, active level, connector grounding, or button behavior.
The source only clarifies how Basic-part eligibility will be identified and does not revise the backlight circuit or its component specifications.
The qualification method does not change the AXP2101 choice, required rails, simultaneous charging behavior, or battery-efficiency goal.
The JLCPCB upload clarification does not resolve or change the VRTC, VBACKUP, or PWROK requirements.
Identifying which components qualify as Basic parts does not change the requirement that all connectors use through-hole assembly.
The qualification method does not change the required current-measurement capability or the conditional omission of a separate INA device.
The JLCPCB upload clarification does not change the confirmed 1.27 mm ESP32 breakout header pitch.
